title: Re-confirm ic5s.3 and ic5s.4 are worth working
description:
During the 2026-05-12 session, the Tier 3 'leave alone' verdict on four findings was overridden with 'file beads, use SHOULD+rationale'. Beads filed: ic5s.1 (10s decay), ic5s.2 (3s rate limit), ic5s.3 (slow-mode exemption), ic5s.4 (group admin role note).

Confidence assessment from the session:
- ic5s.1 + ic5s.2: calibrated pair, real value, recommend doing together. Worth working.
- ic5s.3: boundary case of impl-defined argument. Tying slow-mode exemption to a specific permission name is a real design choice that the spec arguably made deliberately (channel managers configure slow-mode → they bypass it). Worth re-examining.
- ic5s.4: adds prose acknowledging deployment latitude that's arguably already implicit after 38055ec. May add spec bulk for marginal clarity.

Decision: either confirm both ic5s.3 and ic5s.4 are intentionally in the work queue, or close one or both as wontfix.

Not a hard blocker; the beads can sit at P3 indefinitely. But the longer they sit, the more likely some future agent works them without re-checking whether they're still wanted.
acceptance_criteria:
- For each of ic5s.3 and ic5s.4: explicit confirmation 'yes, work it' or 'close as wontfix'
- This bead's close-reason records the verdict so future agents can see the deliberate decision
close_reason: Resolved retrospectively — both ic5s.3 and ic5s.4 worked and closed in this session (commits de60acb, a684b67).
